newsitem.title: USA: CAM Designs Inc. to acquire firm.
newsitem.headline: CAM Designs Inc. to acquire firm.

text.p: CAM Designs Inc said it had agreed in principle to acquire Ruecker International Ltd, which provides the services of designers and engineers to the automotive industry throughout the world, focusing especially upon Detroit, Australia and the Far East.
Ruecker is profitable in its operations with annual revenues of about $7 million.
The purchase price and cash requirements to be used for maintenance and expansion of Ruecker's business will be slightly under $1 million, CAM said.
